text: 其中提到，多方赞赏中国对非洲建交国全面实施零关税，认为这彰显中方对非真实亲诚理念和正确义利观及扩大高水平对外开放的坚定决心。中方乐见多方立足本国区位优势，用好零关税和农产品输华“绿色通道”2.0等举措，并利用中国国际进口博览会、中非经贸博览会等平台，扩大对华出口。祝贺双方签署多哥大豆输华植物检疫要求议定书。双方愿以签署“经认证的经营者”（AEO）项目合作谅解备忘录为契机，进一步深化海关及检验检疫合作。（新华社）
text_en: It was mentioned that various parties appreciated China's full implementation of zero tariffs on African countries with diplomatic relations with China, believing that this demonstrates China's sincere and genuine approach to Africa, its correct approach to justice and interests, and its firm determination to expand high-level opening up. China is pleased to see various parties leverage their own geographical advantages, make good use of measures such as zero tariffs and the "green channel" 2.0 for agricultural products exported to China, and use platforms such as the China International Import Expo and the China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo to expand exports to China. Congratulations were extended on the signing by both sides of the protocol on phytosanitary requirements for Togo soybeans exported to China. Both sides are willing to take the signing of the memorandum of understanding on Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) cooperation as an opportunity to further deepen customs and inspection and quarantine cooperation. (Xinhua News Agency)
